_about: List prices in USD for US East (N. Virginia), copied from the AWS Price List API (https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<service>/current/us-east-1/index.json). Copied on 2026-10-22: AWSQueueService 20260911124607 (SQS standard and FIFO request tiers; the first-million-free tier is part of the list price itself, like Scheduler and SNS, and is applied), AWSEvents 20260924163903 (EventBridge custom events, archive). Reused from chapters 1-3: AmazonApiGateway 20261012212611, AWSLambda 20261012223257, AmazonDynamoDB 20260911124422, AmazonSNS 20260915151944, AmazonCloudWatch 20261007115540, AmazonStates 20260911124511 (Step Functions, for the alternatives table). Where a price has tiers, the tiers cost.py uses are listed; everything else is first tier. No free-tier allowance is applied beyond zero-price first tiers in the list itself. The 2-write-units-per-transactional-item rule is from the DynamoDB developer guide (read/write capacity mode), not a price. Re-check before quoting to anyone.
